children: New Delhi, Oct. 31 -- NTPC vs NTPC Green Energy Q2 results 2026 compared: State-run NTPC Limited and its subsidiary, NTPC Green Energy Limited, have recently announced their second quarter result for the financial year 2026-27. While the Maharatna PSU reported a 38.7% year-on-year (YoY) jump in its Q2 profit, its renewable energy arm reported a 59% annual growth in profit.
As investors will closely track these two PSU stocks' movement on Monday, November 2, post Q2 results announcement, here's a comparison of their Q2 profit, revenue, EBITDA and dividend announcement.

NTPC reported a net profit of Rs.7,029.56 crore in the September quarter of FY27, which is 38.7% higher than Rs.5,066.78 crore reported in the year-ago period. Its net profit stood at Rs.6721.05 crore profit in Q1FY27. NTPC Green Energy's net profit stood at Rs.137.50 crore which is 59% higher than Rs.86.38 crore reported in the year ago period.

The state-run power generation firm reported a 21.2% annual jump in its net consolidated revenue to Rs.54,269.95 crore from Rs.44,784.05 crore a year earlier. Whereas its total income surged to Rs. Rs.54,715.69 crore from Rs.45,262.10 crore, while total expenses increased to Rs.48,059.30 crore from Rs.40,218.03 crore.

NTPC's renewable energy arm, NTPC Green Energy, clocked a 52% annual growth in its total income to Rs.1,000.76 crore from Rs.656.72 crore in the same quarter a year ago. In Q2 FY27, the company's total expenses stood at Rs.876.03 crore as against Rs.551 crore in the year-ago period.

NTPC's earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) increased to Rs. Rs.15,627 crore in Q2FY27, against Rs.12,814 crore in Q2FY26. NTPC Green Energy's EBITDA increased to Rs.544.45 crore from Rs.368.28 crore YoY.

NTPC announced its first interim dividend for FY27, at the rate of 30% ( Rs.3 per equity share) on the face value of Rs.10/- each for the Financial Year 2026-27. NTPC Green Energy didn't announce any dividend alongside its Q2FY27 results.

NTPC share price closed 2.23% higher at Rs.316 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.3,06,414.65 crore on Friday. NTPC Green Energy stock ended 1.74% lower at Rs.82.47 per share with an MCap of Rs.69,491.94 crore.
